criteria.description: Reconcile: As an owner, a reconcile loads the files on disk (root file and all includes, as in step 1). It records one `set` event (`old` = recorded value, or `null` if the leaf was absent; `new` = file value) for each leaf that is new or whose value differs (type-aware comparison), and one `remove` event (`new` = `null`) for each recorded leaf no longer in the files. Ordering follows D-6, all events are recorded atomically, and a reconcile never changes any file.
criteria.evidence: tests/unit/test_reconcile.py (21; changed value, document-order sets then recorded-order removes, null vs remove, never writes files); tests/integration/test_reconcile_first.py (16; US1 scenarios 1-3, 5) — full suite 1275 passed on kitty/mission-troupe-config-sync-files-01M3ZT6R-lane-d (all WP01-WP04 code), plus uv run mypy --strict, ruff check, ruff format --check clean
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator; per-WP independent reviews by reviewer-renata)
criteria.notes: Automated black-box/unit tests mapped from WP requirement_refs; each WP independently reviewed and approved.

criteria.description: No-op edits record nothing: As an owner, an edit that leaves every leaf's type and value unchanged records nothing. Such edits include whitespace, indentation, comments, quoting, scalar spelling of the same value, flow/block style, and replacing an include by equal inline content.

criteria.description: watch readiness line: As an owner, once `watch` has loaded, imported if needed, reconciled, and is able to observe changes to every watched file, it prints exactly one line `watching <dir>` to stdout and flushes it. criteria.description: Watched set follows includes: As an owner, the set of watched files is recomputed on every reconcile. An include added by a hand edit is followed: its leaves are recorded as `set` events, and its file is watched from then on. A file no longer included stops affecting the history.

criteria.description: Each difference recorded once: As an owner, when `watch` and a command, or two reconciles, run around the same time, each difference between the files and the recorded configuration is recorded exactly once.
